title: Apex (The Dor Brothers): storyboard breakdown
subtitle: 73 shots · 3:15 · size / angle / lens / light · move · action · acting · sound. Sound from loudness+spectrogram, cross-checked with Gemini; dialogue lines are Gemini-only (unverified).

shots.move: very fast push through a street canyon
shots.sound: opening hit, loud (-11 LUFS)
shots.why: 0.8 s energy spike before a long calm: the contrast hooks

shots.action: she works at the desk, on the phone, papers
shots.acting: busy, dismissive, avoids eye contact: a normal day
shots.sound: room tone, city hum, rushed phone line; quiet (-30 to -40 LUFS)
shots.why: a long take sets 'normal' so the break hurts

shots.sound: news voice; a low sub-bass drone starts
shots.why: explains the world through a screen in the scene

shots.angle: over the shoulder to the window
shots.action: she watches smoke over the skyline, a helicopter
shots.acting: stillness; we see only her back: dread
shots.sound: drone grows, muffled helicopter, rising whoosh that cuts dead at 0:29
shots.why: the second long hold: tension from waiting

shots.action: the window blows, she is thrown
shots.acting: wide eyes, open mouth, a full-body flinch
shots.sound: impact plus glass; music kicks in (taiko, brass stabs)
shots.why: sound and picture hit on the same frame

shots.sound: crowd screams
shots.why: 0.8 s cutaway: the scale of the event

shots.sound: explosion, debris
shots.why: spectacle shot kept short

shots.action: she clutches herself; a man is blown across the room behind her
shots.acting: shock, frozen for a beat
raw, flailing run, not action-hero smooth

shots.action: she runs toward the camera through debris

shots.why: 0.5 s beats: geography by fragments
costume detail = instant identity

shots.acting: predatory crouch: fear turning into decision

shots.action: her hair in the foreground, chaos behind
shots.why: a soft foreground hides AI face detail
a color/light change marks a new space

shots.action: she bursts out of the emergency exit
shots.why: a god's-eye angle resets the eye

shots.action: she looks up at the street
shots.acting: heavy eye makeup, frozen stare: taking it in

shots.action: she runs across a crosswalk through burning cars
shots.acting: continuous run
shots.sound: dense music, fire, crowd (-10 to -16 LUFS)
shots.why: one long tracking shot inside the fast section = a breather that still moves

shots.action: the avenue erupts in a fireball
shots.sound: big explosion

shots.action: she drives, shouting into the phone
shots.acting: breathless, the voice cracking: the emotional anchor
shots.sound: music ducks; outside muffled by the cabin; phone line (per Gemini: '...I love you... get underground!')
shots.why: interior/exterior sound contrast

shots.action: the vehicle drives through a collapsing street

shots.sound: jet screech

shots.acting: eyes track the threat: reaction sells the plane

shots.action: the plane plunges into the city
the plane lands among the cars
shots.sound: massive distorted explosion, metal groans

shots.acting: set jaw, scanning

shots.action: a flaming car flies across the intersection
a man falls toward the camera
a fire vortex fills the frame
shots.sound: the percussion stops; an ethereal pad starts
shots.why: an abstract transition into the emotional beat

shots.action: she screams into the wind of fire
shots.acting: anguish, hair whipped back
shots.sound: UNDERWATER: highs filtered out (visible as the dark top band in the spectrogram)

shots.action: a small girl stands alone in a pool of light
shots.sound: muffled, dreamlike
shots.why: the emotional stake made visible: one spot of light

shots.action: the hug, the girl looks up
shots.acting: the only tender moment: eyes closed, holding on
shots.sound: pad, then a hard cut back to full chaos at 1:55

shots.acting: resolve replaces fear: furrowed brow, narrowed eyes
shots.sound: action music slams back
shots.why: the micro-expression pivot from fear to resolve

shots.action: the vehicle drives out of the explosion
the vehicle crosses a plaza of explosions

shots.why: product-detail insert: speed without a face

shots.acting: a hard stare into the lens

shots.action: weaving through traffic under a crane

shots.acting: determination
shots.why: face/event alternation at 0.6 s

shots.action: the vehicle pushes through the crowd
the vehicle races along the bridge
the vehicle leaps a broken road

shots.why: location change = time passing, the pace eases a little

shots.action: a silver UFO in the sky
shots.sound: high oscillating whir

shots.acting: disbelief

shots.action: a highway, the UFO in the foreground

shots.acting: sensing danger

shots.action: a semi truck bears down behind her
shots.sound: truck horn, engine

shots.acting: full-body scream
shots.sound: MUSIC HARD STOP on the impact; glass rings out alone
shots.why: the hard stop on impact

shots.action: her hair whips with the impact
shots.why: 0.4 s fragment

shots.sound: thud, then silence
shots.why: slow motion after rapid fragments = the hit lands

shots.action: she sits in an interrogation room
shots.acting: rigid body, darting eyes, defiant stare
shots.sound: silence, echoey room tone
shots.why: total contrast after the chaos: stillness and silence

shots.action: a man in a suit enters, smirking (recognizable likeness: do not copy)
shots.acting: complete relaxation = power
shots.sound: footsteps; line (per Gemini): 'Good morning, sleeping beauty'

shots.action: a bodyguard in sunglasses in the doorway
a man on a phone (public-figure likeness: do not copy)
shots.acting: glacial, unhurried: stillness dominates
shots.sound: phone clatter; line (per Gemini): 'We have her. I'll be right there.'

shots.why: end on the eyes: the hook to the sequel

shots.sound: a final hit, then silence (192.6-194.7 s)
